info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Legal Entity Directory API
info.description: The Legal Entity Directory API provides access to a comprehensive directory of legal entities within the banking sector. This API enables users to retrieve detailed information about various legal entities, helping organizations to verify, analyze, and maintain compliance with regulatory requirements. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, compliance teams, and risk management departments who need to reference accurate legal entity data for their operations. By seamlessly integrating this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and risk assessment processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the comprehensive directory of legal entities, providing insights into their details and statuses for better decision-making and compliance.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve a directory of legal entities in the system. It allows the client to specify parameters for filtering or searching legal entities based on certain criteria.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of legal entities.
